children: DoubleZero co-founder Austin Federa said the company operates its original Shred service at a lower cost and returns 45% of revenue to validators. According to Odaily, Federa also said DoubleZero has provided free high-speed connections for more than 60% of Solana staking and that about 75% of Solana validators are using DoubleZero.

Federa said he had seen some “boring FUD” in private chats from some well-known industry figures, but added that DoubleZero will continue to support Solana. He also said the company plans to launch more services for Solana in the future.

title: DoubleZero Co-Founder Says Firm Supports Solana and Serves Over 75% of Validators
